MVP.name: Most Valuable Player
MVP.label: The eephus selection by in-league eWAR v2, batting plus pitching, summed before rounding. Not a forecast of the BBWAA vote.
MVP.floor_label: Floor: in-league PA of at least 252 or IP of at least 81 (1.55 PA and 0.5 IP per scheduled game, 162 games).
MVP.tie_label: Ties: unrounded score, then in-league WPA, then MLBAM id ascending.
MVP.two_way_label: Two-way: batting and pitching eWAR v2 both count; the row prints the split.

CY.name: Cy Young
CY.label: The eephus selection by in-league pitching eWAR v2. Not a forecast of the BBWAA vote.
CY.floor_label: Floor: in-league IP of at least 41 (0.25 IP per scheduled game, 162 games); relievers stay eligible.
CY.tie_label: Ties: unrounded score, then in-league IP, then SEM+ or REM+ raw, then MLBAM id ascending.

ROY.name: Rookie of the Year
ROY.label: The eephus selection by in-league eWAR v2, both sides, among players who pass the rookie test. Not a forecast of the BBWAA vote.
ROY.floor_label: Floor: PA of at least 100 or IP of at least 30 in the season.
ROY.tie_label: Ties: unrounded score, then in-league WPA, then MLBAM id ascending.
ROY.two_way_label: Two-way: batting and pitching eWAR v2 both count; the row prints the split.
ROY.eligibility_label: Rookie status: at-bats and innings from MLB's season lines; the 45-day roster test is the site's estimate from MLB's transaction log until the site measures service time.

MOY.name: Manager of the Year
MOY.label: The eephus selection by club-season wins above the club's own earned eWAR v2. Not a forecast of the BBWAA vote.
MOY.floor_label: No floor: every club in the league is ranked.
MOY.tie_label: Ties: unrounded score, then wins minus Pythagorean wins, then club code.
MOY.eligibility_label: Club-season. Manager names join when the manager ledger (M-MWAR-2) lands.

eWAR starts from Baseball-Reference's WAR file, with pitching re-priced by the site.
The fWAR reference column and the fielding inputs to DEM+ are FanGraphs' published values.
Every selection, superlative and percentile is computed by eephus.io.
what_this_page_does_not_claim: The eephus selection is not a forecast of the BBWAA vote, and the page prints no probability of winning.
It is not a statement about who merits an award, only the order one published rule gives.
The Rookie test estimates MLB's 45-day roster count from the transaction log until the site measures service time.

Manager of the Year ranks club-seasons, a result players, coaches and the front office share; the decision values on In-Game Management are realized value, not skill, and are never summed across families.
The selection reads eWAR v2 on today's files.
Superlatives measure distance from a grade or a projection and say nothing about effort or character.
My Ballot keeps choices in this browser only; the site collects no ballots.
